units.source_text: 于是讲师升座，用庄严的声音陈述这法会的旨趣。

en.t: Then the lecturer ascended the seat and, in a solemn voice, explained the purpose of this Buddhist service.

units.source_text: 就中指出：“公主厌弃盖世无双的荣华，而在法华经中与大臣永结世世不绝之深缘，此志尊贵无极。”

en.t: In particular, he declared, "The princess has rejected glory unequaled in all the world, and through the Lotus Sutra has formed with the minister a profound bond that will never cease through all their lives to come; this aspiration is noble beyond measure."

units.source_text: 这位讲师是当代学识渊博、口才出众的高僧，

en.t: This lecturer was a high-ranking monk of the age, deeply learned and exceptionally eloquent,

units.source_text: 此时郑重陈述，音调异常尊严，听众无不感动流泪。

en.t: and as he spoke with grave formality, his tone was extraordinarily dignified, and every listener was moved to tears.
